rows.name: Coinbase USDC rewards (Coinbase One)
rows.source_note: Headline rate for paid Coinbase One members (from $4.99/month); rate varies by region and can change monthly. Coinbase Business accounts show 3.60%.
rows.risk_note: Your USDC sits with Coinbase, not in your own wallet. You rely on the company staying solvent; the rate is set by Coinbase and can change. Membership fee reduces the net yield.
